card.title: Outfeel the Room
card.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.

mechanism: A counters disappointing theatre experiences with worse ones of their own until B's request to be heard becomes more support for A.
confusable: Unlike sharing empathy, A must use the comparison to regain the center of attention.
comparison: D115-b turns Dad leaving into Dad demanding a refund; D115-a turns fear of freezing into fear of crying.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
